full_page.content:
Page 49 Cont.
May 16 Mrs. Emily Droste - 28 - Gr. Rapids - Spleen operation to be removed. Alfred Rinklin - 19 - lutherin ( Harper) blind with tuomer on brain. Drs have no hope of recovery.
Alice Bidigare - 45 - pestered ...
Catherine Butterman - 29 - fears nose-cancer. . . had T.B. for 32 years. That was 12 yrs ago. Enrolled about that .... home now & O.K. nine yrs
Margaret Roney - 40 - Employment - fears losing property - already down from $9000. to $1500.
Richard Seegert - 6 mo. - growth on side fears cancer - Lacoma
Mary & Carl Schmidt of Wyandotte 9 and 15 taking to hospital To-day Three little brothers & sisters already + since January
Little Eliz. Collom -
May 11 Page 50 May 25 Mrs. Helen Schenk - now 36 - had diabetis and given up with fever at birth of 4 th baby in August 1934. Enrolled in Ser. Mass Assoc'n here To-day to thank God .... O.K.
Mrs. Unia Ritzler - 62 - diabetis about 14 yrs. Last November lost one toe. Drs. predict they will all have to be amputated. Hopes ..... asks for prayers.
22 Mrs. Agnes Jurgens - 33 - threatening looking wrist - treatments fail- ure ... so far ... fears loss of arm enrolled to-day in Ser. Masses
22 Maurice Logan - 22 - Very peculiar hand-perspiration - Quite a draw- back - hands remarkably moist near always ..... Enrolled To-day.
Cyril Friedel - 30 - wayward - refuses to listen Mother or anyone .... bitter against .... religion ... though still goes to church.
Florence Grummet - 23 - wayward - keeping company with non Cath. & divorced party. Her mother died with flue - 18 yrs. ago - and was raised by grandma .... now leaving home because .... wayward ....
